init.title: VELUX ACTIVE – Window Signing Key
init.description:
To open VELUX windows (not blinds), the VELUX cloud requires an HMAC-SHA512 signature using a HashSignKey that is paired to your KIX 300 gateway during Bluetooth setup.

Paste the key as a hex string (e.g. `a1b2c3...`). Leave blank if you have not yet extracted it.

error.invalid_sign_key: HashSignKey must be a valid hex string (e.g. a1b2c3d4...).
